# Shockadin Paladin — Raid (group)

[Paladin](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Shockadin

*Holy Shock burst and heals with Retribution's melee talents.* (a hybrid: Holy/Retribution).

**✅ Recommended** for raid (the best paladin spec here, or within 3% of it).

**[Shockadin — Holy Shock](../research/raid/builds/shockadin-holy-shock-raid.md)** (23/0/28) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/paladin/60/05025210221021--0523330110130033-12)

## How to play

**Keep up all fight:** **Seal of Righteousness**.

**Talents with no line below:** **Seal of Command**: taken because Vengeance requires it.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Judgement**; no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
2. **Consecration**
3. **Holy Strike**
4. **Divine Favor** right before your next big heal; no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
5. **Holy Shock**
6. **Hammer of Wrath** when the target is below 20% health

Between these, your white swings do the rest.

**Advanced: your cooldowns and extras.** Once the list above feels easy, add these:

- **Retribution Aura**: put it up at the start and keep it up
- **Seal of the Crusader**: put it up at the start and keep it up

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*
